Autonomous deep research — multi-step investigation that browses, verifies, and compiles reports.

Part of [`seek`](seek.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research [options] [command]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`seek research status`](seek-research-status.md) | Inspect one resumable research job without waiting |
| [`seek research get`](seek-research-get.md) | Retrieve one completed research job without waiting |
| [`seek research brave`](seek-research-brave.md) | [Surface] Brave Answers Deep Research |
| [`seek research parallel`](seek-research-parallel.md) | [Thorough] Parallel Deep Research (30s - 25 minutes) |
| [`seek research google`](seek-research-google.md) | [Comprehensive/Planning] Gemini Deep Research Agent (5 - 20 minutes) |
| [`seek research perplexity`](seek-research-perplexity.md) | [Informed] Perplexity Sonar Deep Research (1 - 3 minutes) |

## Exit statuses

`seek research` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
